title: The Gaussian propeller conjecture in every dimension

result.label: The Gaussian propeller conjecture in every dimension
result.statement: Proves that the sum of squared Gaussian first moments of any finite measurable partition is at most 9/(8 ). In dimension at least two, three planar sectors of angle 2 /3, extended orthogonally, attain the bound. Combined with the separate Unique Games theorem, this proves NP-hardness of improving the loss factor (8 /9)(1-1/k) for identity-target kernel clustering with fixed k ≥ 3 on rational centered positive semidefinite inputs.
